exploit_name: LP pool cap exceeded on drawing settlement causing bit-packing overflow
description: Settlement function calculates new LP value without enforcing pool cap constraints. LP earnings can grow by up to 30% per draw without a jackpot winner, exceeding both governance caps and calculated safe limits.
root_cause: Settlement function calculates new LP value without enforcing pool cap constraints. LP earnings can grow by up to 30% per draw without a jackpot winner, exceeding both governance caps and calculated safe limits.
fix_description: Enforce pool cap logic during settlement: validate newLPValue respects calculated and governance limits.
notes: bonusballMax exceeds 255 - normalBallMax causing bit-packing overflow, DoS on max-bonus-ball betting, unfair conditions.
